subject: Clarify add-on economics for retention + tracing + dashboard seats
messages:
From: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@brightleaf.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Rao <maya@brightleaf.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on retention / tracing / dashboard seat pricing

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are close to internal approval but the finance and platform teams want a clearer breakdown of the add-ons. Two specific asks: 

1) How do you price long-term retention versus hot/live retention (30/90/365-day buckets)? Are those metered by GB-ingested, or token-equivalents?
2) Tracing: we need the per-tenant tracing ingest vs storage split and options to cap egress in peak months.
3) Dashboards: can we buy seat-only access for 12 seats plus an optional archival storage top-up?

If you can share a short commercial worksheet and a suggested concession path for a 12–18 month commitment, that would help us finalize the SOW.

Appreciate it — looking to close by end of month.

— Sanjay
Platform Ops, BrightLeaf Health
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@brightleaf.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention / tracing / dashboard seat pricing

Sanjay —

Great questions. I pulled together a short worksheet and a proposed concession path attached (redwood-observability-pricing-v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW stub to capture commitments (draft_sow_brightleaf_v1.pdf). High-level answers below; please see the attachment for rate examples and the four commercial scenarios.

- Retention model: we offer a two-part metering approach. Hot retention (up to 90 days) is charged per GB-ingested (hot rate). Long-term archival (365+ days) is billed at a lower per-GB monthly archival rate with a minimum monthly archive allowance. The worksheet shows per-GB rates and an example migration taper if you move data from hot -> archive.

- Tracing: ingest is metered by span volume and sampled-forward KBs; storage is separate and billed per GB/month. We can add an ingest cap and an overage buffer; see scenario C for a capped ingest + elevated buffer for burst months.

- Dashboards/seats: seat-only licenses are possible. Seats include read/write dash capabilities and limited export credits. Archival top-ups are priced as an add-on SKU (flat monthly).

Concession path (summary): small up-front commitment (12 months) + a 10% list discount on add-ons; 18 months + 15% and a one-time onboarding credit worth $18k for migrations. I flagged a clear path in the worksheet that maps commitment -> discount -> credits.

Next steps: if you want, Ben and Kim can outline the technical limits for tracing caps and Connor can put together an ingress sampling suggestion to hit your forecasted volumes. Happy to hop on a 30 min call this week to walk through the scenarios.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Questions on retention / tracing / dashboard seat pricing

Ava / team —

Looping in Connor for the tracing cap & sampling suggestion. A couple of notes to consider for the commercial framing (internal):

- Keep the hot vs archival language simple in external materials: use 30/90/365 buckets with clear sample customer numbers (GB per month) so finance can model it easily. The spreadsheet does that but the customer asked for explicit examples mapped to their 12 seat ask.
- For concession, prefer to offer a credit (onboarding / migration) rather than an additional percent discount when possible — credits are easier to amortize and limit LT leak.
- If BrightLeaf asks for an ingest cap, we should propose two flavors: (1) hard cap with automated throttling + predictable SLA implications, (2) soft cap with buffer and overage pricing. Option (2) tends to be more acceptable for platform teams.

Connor — can you draft the sampling ladder for Sanjay (low/med/high) and the expected stored GBs for each so we can plug into the worksheet?

— Ben
Sr. Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@brightleaf.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 11:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention / tracing / dashboard seat pricing

Sanjay —

Thanks for the details. I ran a quick back-of-envelope based on the numbers you shared in the POC (avg 4M spans/day, ~12GB/day raw ingest). Attached is a short sampling ladder: Low (5% sample -> ~0.6GB/day stored), Medium (20% -> ~2.4GB/day), High (50% -> ~6.0GB/day). For each we estimate monthly stored GBs and monthly trace storage cost in the worksheet.

Operational options:
- Hard cap: we can enforce a quota at ingest; when hit, events are dropped and you get a throttled response (we'll document SLA tradeoffs).
- Soft cap: allow overshoot up to X% with buffer billing at a pre-agreed overage rate.

If you want to keep headroom in peak months, we recommend Medium + 30% buffer for the first 3 months while you tune sampling. That typically keeps costs predictable while you stabilize.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@brightleaf.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention / tracing / dashboard seat pricing

Ava / team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the worksheet — that is very helpful. A couple of follow-ups before we go to procurement: 

1) BrightLeaf's procurement will accept either a percent discount or a one-time credit; their preferred path is a single-line percent off list for simplicity. Would Redwood be willing to move the 12 month concession to 12 months + 12% off add-ons (instead of 10% + credit)?
2) For dashboards, can you confirm seat-only licensing covers API read-only tokens for our central automation? We need 6 automation tokens + 12 human seats.
3) Can you produce a short SOW stub that includes the sampling ladder and the hard/soft cap options so procurement can attach it to the PO?

If you can confirm the above by COB Monday we'll aim to submit a PO on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Platform Ops, BrightLeaf Health
